Workforce graph explorer

Pick a civil-service (SUCSS) class or an O*NET occupation to see its tasks, skills, technology, related roles, observed AI-usage evidence and labor-market context. Built from the public workforce graph (O*NET 31.0, SUCSS catalog, IPEDS, QCEW, QWI, Anthropic Economic Index).

Read before use. SUCSS to O*NET links are unreviewed lexical title suggestions, not mappings. AI-usage figures are observed Claude usage on tasks, not forecasts and not scores of people. Public aggregate data only; no university employee records.
Subset: administration and business, IT, HR, finance, library, and facilities and trades occupations (O*NET-SOC prefixes 11-3, 13, 15, 25-4, 37, 43, 47, 49, 51-8) and the SUCSS classes with at least one candidate among them. Built by knowledge_graph/export_explorer.py. O*NET 31.0 by USDOL/ETA under CC BY 4.0.
